 IT Security Operations team in Banca Transilvania is looking for a technical team lead focused on use case building while managing the SOC team and its activities.
 Our overall goal is to implement good security practices throughout the existing tooling and also to create security that lasts focusing on end result established in other (more agile) industries, in an integrated manner (partnering with both ICT operations and information security teams) and getting the most out of the available toolset. Our ambition is to become reference points in our area of security expertise for the Romanian banking sector.
 Main responsibilities :
Coordination of threat monitoring, alert triage, prioritization and management of SOC activities and workflows, acting as a technical escalation point for the SOC analysts and when needed escalate situations to other teams, covering SOC level 1 and 2 during 24/7 schedule
Incident response, including escalating to SOC level 3
Provide quality control and feedback for analysts’ investigations
Create and implement SOC use cases in line with MITRE ATT&CK framework
Continuous improvement of SOC use cases, adjusting alerts and/or implementing further automation
Setting up and ensuring the achievement of SOC team objectives, in line with organization needs
Manage SOC team members, identify and address team needs and clarify team concerns
Escalates identified situations involving information security risks to other relevant teams and coordination level, even if these situations do not directly relate to own activities/responsibilities
Serve as a SOC point of contact for other departments, management and other stakeholders
Maintain the operational documentation up to date
Participates in projects and initiatives at direct manager request, contributing with expertise in information security
 Requirements and expectations: 
Ability to analyze event logs, to correlate events from multiple source types and to recognize signs of cyber attacks/intrusions
Knowledge of and experience in threat monitoring, incident response
Graduating an university in a technical field: computer science, automated control, electronics, telecommunications, cybernetics or related.
Minimum 5 years working experience in information systems security. Minimum 1 year of working experience coordinating SOC team of at least 2 security analysts.
Previous experience in security platform administration and security operations engineering is a plus.
International certifications in information systems and/or security is a plus (vendor related or international organizations - CCNA, CISSP, CCSP, CEH etc.).
Previous experience in Banking or in other financial services is a plus.
Integrity, responsibility and professionalism.
Eager to continuously learn and to keep up to date with trends in information security.
Communication and collaboration skills.
Flexibility and agility to support business operations by accommodating changing priorities.
Self-organized, perseverant and results driven; ambition to become best in class in Romanian banking industry for managed security domain.
Proficient in English.
Utilizing AI capabilities within Security tools.
